title: Selector Layer 1 Output
description: Contract output schema for Selector interim form Layer 1 (index-only).

task_summary.description: Brief summary of the discovered documents relevant to the request.

rank.description: Explicit 1-based relevance rank; object key order is not authoritative.

rationale.description: One-line rationale referencing metadata fields only.

discoverable.description: Per-document advisory: whether a follow-up discover() is worthwhile.

status.description: Manifest status label for the document (e.g. draft, active, archive).

warning.description: Optional warning; required in practice for archive items (historical/non-authoritative).

ranked_ids.description: Recommended starting set of document IDs with explicit rank, rationale, per-document discoverability and status. May be empty for gap_type manifest_missing or not_found.

disclaimer.const: recommended starting set, not a boundary

discoverable.description: Aggregate advisory (yes if any ranked document is discoverable). Per-document advisory lives in ranked_ids[*].discoverable.

suggestion.description: Optional free-form suggestion to help the caller.

hint_acknowledgement.description: One-line acknowledgement of caller hints (e.g. 'hints applied' / 'hints not fully applied').

truncated.description: Whether the output was truncated due to budget ceiling.
